files.title: File:Roadway Inn parking lot in Hermiston, Oregon.jpg
files.author: PinchyCC
files.caption: The parking lot of Roadway Inn in Hermiston, Oregon. This view is facing the exit of the model with motel rooms on either side. The visible sky is cloudy but bright sunlight fills half the parking lot, implying an unseen break in the clouds. A member of the staff is pushing a cart to clean a room.
